                    ### Question
                    Which of the following antiarrhythmic drugs can produce thyroid alterations as an adverse effect ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Vernakalant.
opb. Amiodarone
opc. Lidocaine
opd. Diltiazem.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Amiodarone is well-documented to affect thyroid function, causing both hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism due to its high iodine content and effects on thyroid hormone metabolism. Vernakalant has limited data regarding thyroid effects and is not commonly associated with thyroid alterations. Lidocaine primarily affects cardiac conduction and has no significant reports of thyroid alterations. Diltiazem, a calcium channel blocker, is also not associated with changes in thyroid function. Therefore, the only antiarrhythmic drug among the options that can produce thyroid alterations as an adverse effect is Amiodarone.
